what_happened.line: The committee used November 13, the second Tuesday in November, as the working date for a fall special town meeting.
The chair recommended pulling back from major charter changes to the cemetery, park and library board roles.
The committee agreed to revisit how the town accountant is appointed, checking what other towns' charters do.
A proposal was raised to split the charter changes into separate articles for Town Meeting; the discussion ended without a resolution.
The next meeting was set for June 27.

why_it_matters: Residents may be asked at a special town meeting to vote on charter changes, and separate articles would let them accept or reject each change on its own rather than as one package.
Changes to who appoints the town accountant, and to how the cemetery, park and library boards are set up, bear on how town finances and those services are overseen.
watch_next: Public hearings and the fall special town meeting, with November 13 as the working date.
